records.jp: ……うーん。<CR>あれ？　私……寝てた？
records.en_original: Ngh... Huh? I fell asleep?
records.en: Ngh... Huh? I fell asleep?

records.jp: （えーと、たしか詩さんと一緒に寝転んで<CR>いろいろ喋ってて……）
records.en_original: (Let's see... Last thing I remember is chatting with Uta while on the bed...)
records.en: (Let's see... Last thing I remember is chatting with Uta-san while on the bed...)

records.jp: （ベッドふかふかで気持ちいいなーってなってたら、<CR>いつの間にか、寝落ちてた！？）
records.en_original: (I must have fallen asleep after getting too comfy!)
records.en: (I must have fallen asleep after getting too comfy!)

records.jp: （もしかして、詩さんのことほったらかしで<CR>寝落ちてたとか！？）
records.en_original: (I hope Uta doesn't feel neglected!)
records.en: (I hope Uta-san doesn't feel neglected!)

records.jp: 詩さん、ごめ――
records.en_original: Uta, I'm sorr—
records.en: Uta-san, I'm sorr—

records.jp: （あ、寝てる……）
records.en_original: (She's asleep.)
records.en: (She's asleep.)

records.jp: （うーん。どうしたらいいかな……<CR>よく眠ってるし、起こすのは可哀想かな）
records.en_original: (What to do... She looks so peaceful, I'd feel bad waking her up.)
records.en: (What to do... She looks so peaceful, I'd feel bad waking her up.)

records.jp: （でも、いつまでも寝てると、<CR>みんなに心配されそうだし……）
records.en_original: (But the others will probably worry if I let her sleep all day...)
records.en: (But the others will probably worry if I let her sleep all day...)

records.jp: （とりあえず、<CR>みんなに事情を話しに行ってこよう）
records.en_original: (For now, I'll go to tell everyone the situation.)
records.en: (For now, I'll go to tell everyone the situation.)

records.jp: （起こさないように……っと）
records.en_original: (Just gotta make sure I don't wake her up...)
records.en: (Just gotta make sure I don't wake her up...)

records.jp: ん……星崎さん。おはようございます
records.en_original: Mmm... Good morning, Ao.
records.en: Mmm... Good morning, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: あ、ごめん。起こしちゃった？
records.en_original: Oops, sorry. Did I wake you up?
records.en: Oops, sorry. Did I wake you up?

records.jp: あ……私、眠ってしまっていたんですね……
records.en_original: Ah... I fell asleep, did I?
records.en: Ah... I fell asleep, did I?

records.jp: ふふっ、おはよ
records.en_original: Hehe... Rise and shine.
records.en: Hehe... Rise and shine.

records.jp: （うーん。もうちょっとこのまま<CR>寝かせておいてあげたいな……）
records.en_original: (Hmm... I'll let her sleep a bit longer.)
records.en: (Hmm... I'll let her sleep a bit longer.)

records.jp: （普段はあんまじっくり見る機会なんて無いけど……<CR>詩さんって……やっぱ、綺麗だなぁ……）
records.en_original: (I've never really looked at Uta so closely before... She really is pretty.)
records.en: (I've never really looked at Uta-san so closely before... She really is pretty.)

records.jp: （肌とか透き通るように白くて、まつ毛長くて……<CR>あ、ほっぺがほんのりピンクだ……）
records.en_original: (Her skin is clear, her eyelashes are long... Ah, her cheeks are the tiniest bit pink...)
records.en: (Her skin is clear, her eyelashes are long... Ah, her cheeks are the tiniest bit pink...)

records.jp: （あ。笑ってる……可愛い！　じゃなくて！<CR>いい夢、見てるといいなぁ……）
records.en_original: (Oh, she's smiling! She's so cute! Wait, now's not the time! Sh-she must be having a nice dream.)
records.en: (Oh, she's smiling! She's so cute! Wait, now's not the time! Sh-she must be having a nice dream.)

records.jp: （……あ。やばい。起こしちゃった）
records.en_original: (...Oh, shoot, I woke her up.)
records.en: (...Oh, shoot, I woke her up.)

records.jp: ……星崎さん？
records.en: ...Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: あ、あは……おはよ……
records.en_original: Ahaha... Morning.
records.en: Ahaha... Morning.

records.jp: 私……寝てしまって……？
records.en_original: Did I fall asleep?
records.en: Did I fall asleep?

records.jp: うん。私も寝ちゃってて、いま起きたとこ
records.en_original: Yeah. I fell asleep too, and woke up just now.
records.en: Yeah. I fell asleep too, and woke up just now.

records.jp: せっかく話をしていたのに、私、いつの間にか……<CR>すみません
records.en_original: You took the time to talk with me, and I up and fell asleep... I'm very sorry.
records.en: You took the time to talk with me, and I up and fell asleep... I'm very sorry.

records.jp: そっか。なら、ほっとした～。<CR>私も、詩さん放って寝落ちちゃったと思ってたし
records.en_original: Oh, that's a relief. I thought I was the one that had fallen asleep, leaving you all alone.
records.en: I see. Then what a relief. I thought I'd fallen asleep and left you alone too, Uta-san.

records.jp: つまり……ふふ。<CR>ふたりして寝てしまったということですね
records.en_original: Which means... Hehe. It seems we both fell asleep at the same time.
records.en: Which means... Hehe. It seems we both fell asleep at the same time.

records.jp: このベッド、とても寝心地が良いです
records.en_original: This bed is quite comfortable.
records.en: This bed is quite comfortable.

records.jp: だよね。てか、このベッドってさ……
records.en_original: Right? Y'know, this bed...
records.en: Right? Y'know, this bed...

records.jp: ロマンチックだよね。<CR>お花でいっぱいでさ……
records.en_original: It's pretty romantic, don't you think? All these flowers...
records.en: It's pretty romantic, don't you think? All these flowers...

records.jp: なんか、お花畑で寝てるみたいだなぁって。<CR>気持ちよくて、つい寝ちゃうわけだよー
records.en_original: It's like sleeping in the middle of a field of flowers! It feels so nice, you fall right asleep.
records.en: It's like sleeping in the middle of a field of flowers! It feels so nice, you fall right asleep.

records.jp: 花びらに埋もれて眠る……<CR>私はむしろ、不吉なものを連想しました
records.en_original: Asleep on a bed of flowers... It makes me think of something a little morbid...
records.en: Asleep on a bed of flowers... It makes me think of something a little morbid...

records.jp: え？　不吉って、まさか……
records.en_original: Huh? By morbid, you don't mean...
records.en: Huh? By morbid, you don't mean...

records.jp: ……お葬式です
records.en_original: ...It's just like a funeral.
records.en: ...It's just like a funeral.

records.jp: やっぱそれだったー！<CR>私たち、ふたりしてお葬式ごっこしちゃった！？
records.en_original: I knew you were gonna say that! It looked like they were holding a funeral for the both of us, didn't it?!
records.en: I knew you were gonna say that! It looked like they were holding a funeral for the both of us, didn't it?!

records.jp: お葬式……というより、心中でしょうか。<CR>棺ではなく、ベッドに寝ていたので
records.en_original: I think it looked more like a lover's suicide. We were on a bed, not in a casket, after all.
records.en: I think it looked more like a lover's suicide. We were on a bed, not in a casket, after all.

records.jp: 心中かぁ……それはそれでロマンチックかも。<CR>ロミジュリみたいでさ
records.en_original: A lover's suicide... I guess that's pretty romantic too. Just like Romeo and Juliet.
records.en: A lover's suicide... I guess that's pretty romantic too. Just like Romeo and Juliet.

records.jp: あ、でも別に、死にたいとかじゃないよ？
records.en_original: Ah, I don't really wanna die though, you know?
records.en: Ah, I don't really wanna die though, you know?

records.jp: はい。気持ち良く眠って、目を覚ましましたから。<CR>でも……星崎さんとなら、悪くない気もします
records.en_original: Yes, of course. We just had a nice nap, that's all. Though... I wouldn't mind if it was with you, Ao.
records.en: Yes, of course. We just had a nice nap, that's all. Though... I wouldn't mind if it was with you, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: えへ。そうかな……って、うっかり流されかけた！<CR>死ぬとかはやっぱダメだから！
records.en_original: Hehe, you mean it? Hey, wait! I got distracted by the compliment! No dying allowed, you hear?!
records.en: Hehe, you mean it? Hey, wait! I got distracted by the compliment! No dying allowed, you hear?!

records.jp: はい。こうしてふたりで目を覚ます方が、<CR>私も素敵だと思います
records.en_original: Yes, Ao. I think it's much more special waking up next to you like this.
records.en: Yes, Ao. I think it's much more special waking up next to you like this.

records.jp: 魔のベッドだよ！<CR>どー考えたって、呪いがかかってる！
records.en_original: This bed is cursed! No doubt about it!
records.en: This bed is cursed! No doubt about it!

records.jp: え？　魔のベッド……呪い、ですか？
records.en_original: Cursed...you say?
records.en: Cursed...you say?

records.jp: そう。あまりの寝心地の良さで、<CR>誰でも強制的に寝落ちさせる呪い！
records.en_original: Yeah. It's so comfortable that it's impossible for anyone to escape the ruthlessly calming clutches of sleep!
records.en: Yeah. It's so comfortable that it's impossible for anyone to escape the ruthlessly calming clutches of sleep!

records.jp: いばら姫のベッドもこんなやつだったに違いない！
records.en_original: I bet that Sleeping Beauty's bed was like this!
records.en: I bet that Sleeping Beauty's bed was like this!

records.jp: おとぎ話ですか？<CR>確かあれは、ベッドが原因ではなかったかと……
records.en_original: A fairy tale, correct? Wasn't she put to sleep by a poisoned apple...?
records.en: A fairy tale, correct? Wasn't she put to sleep by a poisoned apple...?

records.jp: ごめん。調子乗りました……。<CR>私、ファンタジーとか好きで……あはは……
records.en_original: Oops, guess I got carried away with my fantasies... Ahaha...
records.en: Oops, guess I got carried away with my fantasies... Ahaha...

records.jp: ……つまり、それだけ寝心地が良かったと、<CR>表現したかったんですね？
records.en_original: You mean to say that this bed is extremely comfortable, correct?
records.en: You mean to say that this bed is extremely comfortable, correct?

records.jp: ……はい。変なモード入ってごめんね？
records.en_original: Exactly. Sorry for being weird.
records.en: Exactly. Sorry for being weird.

records.jp: いえ。大まかな意図は読み取れましたから。<CR>一瞬、何を意味しているのか戸惑いましたが……
records.en_original: It's all right. I was able to understand what you meant. Though I was quite confused for a moment...
records.en: It's all right. I was able to understand what you meant. Though I was quite confused for a moment...

records.jp: あはは……だよね
records.en_original: Ahaha... I think that's understandable.
records.en: Ahaha... I think that's understandable.

records.jp: でも……そうですね、つい眠ってしまうくらいには<CR>寝心地は良かったと思います
records.en_original: You are right, however. It's so comfortable that we both drifted off.
records.en: You are right, however. It's so comfortable that we both drifted off.

records.jp: だよね！
records.en_original: Right!
records.en: Right!

records.jp: それに……いつになく安心して眠れた……<CR>そんな気がします
records.en_original: I do feel, however, that I was able to sleep unusually deeply.
records.en: I do feel, however, that I was able to sleep unusually deeply.

records.jp: 「いつになく」って、普段はあんま眠れないの？<CR>ま、ここって雑魚寝状態だし、しょーがないけど
records.en_original: Unusually? Does that mean you usually have trouble sleeping? I guess it is hard to get some privacy here...
records.en: Unusually? Does that mean you usually have trouble sleeping? I guess it is hard to get some privacy here...

records.jp: あ、いえ。ここでの生活はだいぶ慣れました。<CR>ただ……気付いたんです
records.en_original: It's not that. I've mostly gotten used to daily life here. It's just that...I've noticed something.
records.en: It's not that. I've mostly gotten used to daily life here. It's just that...I've noticed something.

records.jp: 今の眠りがとても心地よかったので、<CR>普段はそう感じていなかった、ということに
records.en_original: My sleep was so restful just now, it made me realize that I must sleep very lightly most of the time.
records.en: My sleep was so restful just now, it made me realize that I must sleep very lightly most of the time.

records.jp: そっか……詩さん、普段って<CR>あんまりよく寝れてないんだ……
records.en_original: So you haven't been able to sleep well...
records.en: I see... You usually don't sleep very well, Uta-san...

records.jp: それじゃ、疲れ取れないんじゃない？
records.en_original: Are you still tired when you wake up?
records.en: Are you still tired when you wake up?

records.jp: いえ……こういうものだと慣れてましたし
records.en_original: Yes, but I've become used to that.
records.en: Yes, but I've become used to that.

records.jp: いやいや、慣れちゃダメだって！<CR>疲れがたまると、いろいろ良くないよ？
records.en_original: That's terrible! What's the point of sleep if you're still tired after!
records.en: That's terrible! What's the point of sleep if you're still tired after!

records.jp: お肌にも悪いし、体調悪くなるし、<CR>なにより悪い方向にものを考えやすくなるし！
records.en_original: It's bad for your skin, you feel crummy, and you get cranky easily!
records.en: It's bad for your skin, you feel crummy, and you get cranky easily!

records.jp: そういうもの……なんですか
records.en_original: Is all that...really all true?
records.en: Is all that...really all true?

records.jp: うん。睡眠の質って大事だっていうよ！<CR>詩さんはもっと、自分を労わらなきゃ！
records.en_original: It is. Getting good sleep is so important! You've gotta take better care of yourself!
records.en: Yeah. They say sleep quality is important! You need to take better care of yourself, Uta-san!

records.jp: 自分を労わる……ですか？<CR>それなら、労わっていると思います
records.en_original: I think I take care of myself...
records.en: I think I take care of myself...

records.jp: 私は人と違うことを考えがちなので、<CR>摩擦を避けるために、考えを口にしないように……
records.en_original: I find that I think about things different than others, so I often avoid speaking about my thoughts to avoid unnecessary friction...
records.en: I find that I think about things different than others, so I often avoid speaking about my thoughts to avoid unnecessary friction...

records.jp: うわー！　そういうの、ダメだから！<CR>それに、私にはいろいろ話してくれるじゃん
records.en_original: Whoa, don't do that! You talk to me about stuff, don't you?
records.en: Whoa, don't do that! You talk to me about stuff, don't you?

records.jp: それは……星崎さんは、私の考えたことを話しても<CR>変な目で見ないので、つい甘えてしまっていて……
records.en_original: That's because...you never judge me for sharing my thoughts. I've allowed myself to be spoiled by you...
records.en: That is... because you don't look at me strangely even when I share my thoughts, Hoshizaki-san, so I end up relying on your kindness...

records.jp: うわー。詩さん、ますますダメだからー！<CR>こーなったら、私が詩さんを労わらなきゃ！
records.en_original: Uta, that's no good! I guess I'll just have to take care of you!
records.en: Uta-san, that's no good! I guess I'll just have to take care of you!

records.jp: そうだ！<CR>いいこと思いついたよ！
records.en_original: Wait! I've got an idea!
records.en: Wait! I've got an idea!

records.jp: いいこと……ですか？
records.en_original: An idea?
records.en: An idea?

records.jp: うん！　詩さんがよく寝られる方法！
records.en_original: Yep! A way you can sleep better!
records.en: Yeah! A way for you to sleep better, Uta-san!

records.jp: このベッドでよく寝られたんならさ、<CR>いっそここで寝るとよくない？
records.en_original: You said your sleep here was better, why not just sleep in this bed?
records.en: You said your sleep here was better, why not just sleep in this bed?

records.jp: それと、勇希とかと一緒にやたら運動するの！<CR>体が疲れると、よく寝られるっていうし！
records.en_original: Maybe you could exercise with Yuki too! If you tire out your body, you'll get better sleep!
records.en: Maybe you could exercise with Yuki too! If you tire out your body, you'll get better sleep!

records.jp: ……星崎さんは、私を心配してくれるんですね
records.en_original: You are worried about me I see.
records.en: ...You worry about me, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: そりゃ心配するよ！<CR>あんないい寝顔見ちゃったら、猶更だよ！
records.en_original: Of course I am! Now that I've seen how cute you are when you sleep, I have to make sure you sleep well!
records.en: Of course I am! Now that I've seen how cute you are when you sleep, I have to make sure you sleep well!

records.jp: ……不思議なんですが、私が良く眠れたのは、<CR>星崎さんが隣にいたからのような気がします
records.en_original: It's strange... I get the feeling that I was able to sleep so well because I was next to you, Ao.
records.en: It's strange... I get the feeling that I was able to sleep so well because I was next to you, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: えっ、私！？
records.en_original: N-next to me?!
records.en: N-next to me?!

records.jp: 星崎さんと一緒にいると、ほっとします。<CR>ですから、そのせいかと……
records.en_original: I find your presence to be very calming. Perhaps that's why...
records.en: I feel at ease when I'm with you, Hoshizaki-san. So perhaps that is why...

records.jp: だったらさ……ちょっと恥ずかしいんだけど……<CR>たまにこうやって、一緒にお昼寝しよっか！
records.en_original: In that case... This might be little embarrassing, but I don't mind taking a nap together every now and again!
records.en: In that case... This might be little embarrassing, but I don't mind taking a nap together every now and again!

records.jp: 星崎さんが良ければ、ぜひ
records.en_original: If that's all right with you, please.
records.en: If that's all right with you, Hoshizaki-san, then by all means.

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
